visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair tied back and wearing a white lace-patterned top is shown from the chest up. She smiles towards the camera against a plain white background. An inset video shows hands using a powder puff on a mosaic-style powder. (2) The scene shifts to a retail display stand featuring multiple gold-cased face powders with multi-colored mosaic patterns inside. Close-up shots highlight the different shades and the Elegance brand logo. (3) The woman returns to the frame, holding a gold compact. She uses a white powder puff to take product and applies it to her cheeks and forehead. Close-ups show her hands manipulating the puff and the fine texture of the powder. (4) A split-screen comparison shows one side of her face with powder and the other without. Text overlays indicate the difference in skin texture. (5) The camera shows a store shelf with green and white bottles of skincare products labeled ALBION. A hand is seen pouring liquid onto a white cotton pad and wiping it across skin. (6) The woman appears again with several small white pads applied to her face like a mask. She then removes them and touches her cheek, which appears hydrated and glowing. (7) Footage of an airport duty-free shop is shown, featuring the 'Fasola' and 'ALBION' signage. (8) The woman holds up a promotional voucher and a skincare mask packet, smiling at the camera. (9) The video ends with a close-up of the gold Elegance compact being opened to reveal the colorful powder.
